name: embed-code
title: Embed Code
description: Reads back what visitors will see and what the embed tracks, offers a privacy mode and allowed-site list, and catches drafts, private resources and secrets in the URL (token=, sig=) with a one-tap strip before a deliberate second click copies it.

meta.summary: Reads back what an embed will show and track, and strips tokens from its URL, so an embed doesn't leak a private link or secret.
meta.server: Scope embed tokens to read-only, short-lived access on the server, and enforce allowed origins with frame-ancestors.
catches: Secrets in the embed URL (token=, sig= and similar)
Draft or private resources about to be embedded
Tracking the embed adds, with a privacy-mode option
Allowed-site entries that aren't valid domains
limits: Exposure and tracking come from the resource description you pass
Stripping a token may break an embed that genuinely needs it
a11y: Labelled options and allowed-domain field with aria-invalid and aria-describedby
Readback rows use icons plus text
